The ESS-S3011A from Noise Ken is an Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) Simulator that generates electrostatic discharge of up to 30 kV. It can perform testing of devices to check for ESD effects and ensure high reliability as per IEC 61000-4-2 & ISO 10605 standards. This ESD simulator consists of a GT-30RB discharge gun, a discharge generator, a discharge detection function, and an optical interface. The tip of this simulator allows for a waveform with higher peak amplitude and a faster rise time, enabling precise simulation of ESD events. This ESD simulator operates in contact and air discharge mode and allows gun/main/external triggers. It has a voltage range of 0.20 to 30 kV. This simulator can discharge up to 60000 times and has a repetition cycle of 0.05 to 600 s. 
The ESS-S3011A includes an intuitive operation menu that offers easy design and configuration of parameters such as test voltage and application frequency. This simulator supports 3 built-in pre-check functions – high-voltage power supply output check, insulation failure check, and discharge relay operation check, ensuring reliable testing. It also has a white LED irradiator to facilitate the visualization of discharging areas using control software from a remote desktop PC. This ESD simulator requires an AC supply of 100 to 240 V and consumes 75 kVA of power. It measures 392 x 312 x 295.3 mm.
